voice_lines: At home, a unit costs about eight rupees. Public fast chargers often charge over twenty, so your cost per kilometre can nearly triple.
It can still work if you can charge at your office or society, or there's a charger near home you'll actually use every week.
Count the time too. A weekly charging stop is like a fuel stop, just longer.
No regular charging spot? A hybrid or CNG car will be easier. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Thinking EV but no charger at home? ⚡

Home charging: roughly ₹8 a unit. Public DC fast charging: often ₹20+ a unit. Your cost per km can nearly triple (approximate, varies by city and charger).

It can still work if:
✅ You can charge at your office or society
✅ There's a charger near home you'll use weekly

No regular charging spot? A hybrid or CNG car is the easier life.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
